findings.title: watchMyStatus(cb) references a uid that does not exist in module scope
findings.location: design §7.1 (watchMyStatus), §5 (ownership split), §7.3 (enterGame wiring); index.html module block ~lines 516-688, currentUid declared main-script line 775
findings.problem: watchMyStatus(cb) is specified as onSnapshot(doc(db, USERS, uid), ...), but the Firebase module keeps no current-uid variable. Every existing module method that needs the id takes it as a parameter (loadProfile(uid) line 640, saveProfile(uid,...) line 648). currentUid is a main-script variable (line 775) unreachable from the module, so the bare uid does not resolve and the snapshot cannot be created as written. enterGame wires cloud().watchMyStatus(onMyStatus) with no uid.
findings.fix: Either (a) thread the id through to match the existing param convention: watchMyStatus(uid, cb) { return onSnapshot(doc(db, USERS, uid), s => cb(s.data())); } and call cloud().watchMyStatus(currentUid, onMyStatus); or (b) read auth.currentUser.uid inside the wrapper. Also specify a no-op unsubscribe when auth/db is missing so unsubMyStatus?.() is always safe. Option (a) matches the file's (uid, ...) pattern.

findings.title: Inaccurate enumeration of existing state strings ("pause", "countdown")
findings.location: design §5 and §13 finding 3; index.html states at lines 2171, 2204 ("paused"), el map 741-742
findings.problem: The design lists existing state values including "pause" and "countdown". The actual pause state string is "paused" (lines 2171, 2204), and there is no "countdown" state; pause/countdown are only element ids / el handles. Real states: auth, start, playing, battle, levelClear, gameOver, paused.
findings.fix: Correct the enumeration to the verified set (note "paused" and "battle", drop "countdown"). Does not affect correctness: the new state = "pending" is unique against all actual states, so the no-collision claim still holds.

findings.title: enterGame role branch must explicitly cover the null/cache-only/default profile case
findings.problem: enterGame derives profile from loadProfile -> getCached -> a default literal {name,best:0,level:1,grade:1,speed:2} (lines 1109-1111). The default and cached objects carry no role, like legacy docs. §7.3's branch text reads as if role/status is always present; §7.4 covers missing-role but the wording leaves the brand-new/cache-only branch ambiguous.
findings.fix: State the three branches explicitly: adult (role in {teacher,parent}); pending student (role=='student' && status=='pending'); everything else including missing role / cached-only / default -> active+legacy backfill path.

findings.title: Legacy backfill cannot be written through the existing saveProfile
findings.problem: saveProfile(uid, {...}) destructures a fixed field list with no role/status/approvedBy, and the design forbids adding those to its signature (§4.5, §7.1). So 'backfill role/status/approvedBy via the existing saveProfile' would silently drop the new fields and never backfill.
findings.fix: Name a distinct write for the backfill, e.g. MathQuestCloud.backfillRole(uid) doing setDoc(users/{uid}, {role:'student', status:'active', approvedBy:null}, {merge:true}); it goes through the self-update rule branch (not the create rule), so the create-rule best==0 constraint is not disturbed, consistent with §4.1.
